description: Spanish National Access Point provides Spain's national access point for multimodal passenger-transport information. The provider is Spanish Ministry of Transport. Geographical and temporal coverage: The national portal lets developers and other consumers use registered transport information freely and without charge. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Licencia de datos abiertos del Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
